question: Should ClickClack permanently support separate alignment preferences for the current user's messages and all other participants' messages?
rationale: The patch is a well-proven new preference and persistence surface, but repository evidence does not establish that this additional UX setting has already been accepted as product direction.

options.title: Approve independent settings
options.body: Land the two-setting model while preserving left alignment as the default and keeping focused layout coverage.

options.title: Keep one setting
options.body: Ask the contributor to retain the existing single preference and avoid adding another permanent stored option.

options.title: Decline configurable alignment
options.body: Close the PR if participant-side customization is outside the intended appearance model.

recommendation.title: Approve independent settings
recommendation.body: Land the two-setting model while preserving left alignment as the default and keeping focused layout coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the best available history-based routing candidate for deciding a permanent web appearance preference.
